name: Pipeliners - Session Handoff 2026-10-01
body:
> Handoff · Pipeliners · 2026-10-01

# Summary
A full handoff built from 122 Claude Code session transcripts (2026-05-18 to 2026-10-01) that touched Pipeliners. Where sessions disagreed, the latest verified state wins and conflicts are called out. Dates are server UTC; Kim works in Philippine time, so some folder names carry the next day's date.

# Status by workstream (as of Oct 1)
- **Blogs:** 51 live posts, 11 drafts (all 301'd merges, never deleted), 1 private. Published this cycle: UV cured lining 17978 (Aug 28), slab leaks Phoenix 18117 (Sep 7), sewer line maintenance 18123 (Sep 14), sewer smell 18137 (Sep 16), clay sewer pipe 18150 (Sep 18), main sewer line clog 18157 (Sep 25). 9 merges live Sep 18. 38 posts aligned to one focus keyword Sep 23 (168 OTTO edits). Not-indexed rewrites and AI-answer batches 1-3 live Sep 28. Orphan-link fix live Oct 1.
- **City pages (37):** all rewritten for uniqueness (Jul 13 and Aug 27-28), uniform design (4 boxes, CTA Final V2 17218, FAQ FINAL 17391, Hero 17397), one Elementor FAQ and one FAQPage each. Many September waves (quick wins, step 7/8 titles, wave 1-2, Goodyear, Gold Canyon, Batch 1 Elementor rewrites, 8 OTTO H1s).
- **Images:** Sep 30 audit then fixes 1-5 live (19 OTTO alt overrides, 51 library alts, 24 city hero backgrounds, Buckeye stock photo replaced). OTTO overrides library alts per image URL.
- **Schema:** Service + nested LocalBusiness on all 37 city pages via OTTO (Aug 18), FAQ via `_pipeliners_faq_jsonld`, Article schema on 2 posts.
- **Indexing:** 104 indexed, 160 not (about 146 correct exclusions). Sitemap cleaned to the MetaSync virtual sitemap (110 URLs).
- **Google Ads (read-only):** 4 of 5 primary conversion actions stopped late July; only the GHL offline call upload is alive.
- **GHL:** number pool swaps are intentional; IVR workflow published Jul 2, live test call pending.
- **Performance:** organic clicks flat at about 25-35 a month; Sep 17 impression cliff was Google's 100-results change; AI visibility 44/100.

# Pending (as of Oct 1)
- **Waiting on Kim (13):** approve the 24/7 and same-day reword, approve 6 ad-touched city H1s, decide whether to narrow the ad rule, pick lining-vs-replacement and CIPP owner pages, rewrite or retire /pipeline-locating/, approve the top-10-signs merge, merge or noindex 7 small city pages, naming rule retroactive or not, free a Search Atlas AI slot, move a tracker share pin, answer the Maricopa/Anthem ad-check question, approve content-plan drafts, optional /category/pipeliners/ meta.
- **Waiting on Scott (8):** unconfirmed claims and ROC, the hidden homepage price table, real job photos, residential guide merge, commercial scope, owner of (480) 969-7978, GBP service list, IVR test call.
- **Dated checks:** Oct 5 Scorecard first read, Oct 9 baseline review of 13 pages, Oct 10 Buckeye 4-week check, Oct 12-27 reads of September edits, Oct 26 blog full read, mid-October GSC Validate fix (Tempe, Gilbert), late October AI visibility recheck, Oct 29 Keystone leads pull.

# Conflicts resolved
24/7 (Scott Oct 1 "do not mention" wins over Aug 26-31), author (Jake Shaker wins), autopilot (crawl Never verified), cache flush (never), GSC sitemaps (cleanup approved Sep 14), hardcoded phone numbers in old FAQ answers, Ads account (7219095860 is Pipeliners, 1401013750 is Summit).

# Artifacts listed (private to Kim)
Website Pages tracker, SEO Results Scorecard, Content plan, Search Checkup, Multi-client tracker, Audit + clusters, Three-page audit, Blog keyword positions, Corrected growth plan (links are in the source file).
